title: Backup and Recovery Standard
text: Acme Cloud creates nightly incremental backups retained for 60 days. Weekly full backups are retained for 16 weeks. The target recovery time is 8 hours and target recovery point is 4 hours. This version has been superseded.

title: Backup and Recovery Standard
text: Acme Cloud creates nightly incremental backups retained for 35 days. Weekly full backups are retained for 12 weeks. The target recovery time objective (RTO) is 4 hours and the recovery point objective (RPO) is 1 hour.

title: Security Audit Logging Policy
text: Security audit logs recording administrative and authentication events are retained for 400 days. User activity audit logs are retained for 180 days. This policy does not define application log retention.

title: Security Incident Response Plan
text: Critical security incidents must be acknowledged by the security team within 15 minutes. Affected enterprise customers are notified within 24 hours after a confirmed material incident. High severity incidents require acknowledgement within 30 minutes.

title: Customer Support SLA
text: Priority 1 support cases receive an initial response within 20 minutes. Priority 2 cases receive an initial response within 2 hours. Priority 3 cases receive an initial response within 8 business hours.

title: Access Control Policy
text: Privileged access is reviewed every 30 days. Standard user access is reviewed quarterly. Inactive user accounts are disabled after 45 days without activity. Privileged access requires multi-factor authentication.

title: Encryption and Key Management Standard
text: Customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3. Production encryption keys are rotated every 180 days. Key material is stored in a managed key management service.

title: Workspace Deletion Policy
text: Deleted workspaces remain recoverable for 30 days. After the recovery window, primary data is permanently removed. Residual encrypted backup copies are purged within 45 additional days.

title: Backup and Disaster Recovery Policy
text: Northstar Analytics retains nightly database backups for 21 days and monthly archives for 6 months. Its recovery time objective is 6 hours and recovery point objective is 2 hours.

title: Audit Logging Standard
text: Northstar keeps privileged security audit logs for 730 days and standard user audit logs for 365 days. These values apply only to Northstar workspaces.

title: Incident Management Policy
text: Northstar acknowledges severity-one security incidents within 30 minutes and sends customer notification within 48 hours after confirming material impact.

title: Support Service Levels
text: Northstar Priority 1 support requests receive an initial response within 45 minutes. Priority 2 requests receive a response within 4 hours.

title: Identity and Access Management Policy
text: Northstar reviews privileged access every 60 days and disables inactive accounts after 90 days. Administrative sessions require multi-factor authentication.

title: Cryptography Standard
text: Northstar encrypts stored customer data with AES-256 and uses TLS 1.2 or later for network transport. Customer-data encryption keys rotate every 365 days.

title: Data Deletion Procedure
text: Northstar deleted workspaces have a 14-day recovery period. Backup remnants are removed within 60 days after the recovery period ends.
